steps.en: Mobile numbers are fetched from the government data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile diambil dari sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: Lookup code exists but is switched off in the prod config; source unconfirmed.
steps.why_id: Code lookup ada tapi dimatikan di konfigurasi prod; sumber belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Unique individuals are identified so each person gets one SMS
steps.id: Individu yang unik dikenali supaya tiap orang dapat satu SMS
steps.why_en: Grouping per person exists, but only for parking reminders.
steps.why_id: Pengelompokan per orang ada, tapi hanya untuk reminder parking.

steps.en: The SMS body carries court summons details
steps.id: Isi SMS memuat detail court summons
steps.why_en: SMS text is built from parking reminder data only; no court summons content.
steps.why_id: Isi SMS hanya dari data reminder parking; tidak ada konten court summons.

steps.en: OCMS sends the SMS reminder to the defendant
steps.id: OCMS mengirim SMS reminder ke defendant
steps.why_en: SMS sending code exists but is switched off in the prod config and is not court-specific.
steps.why_id: Code kirim SMS ada tapi dimatikan di konfigurasi prod dan bukan khusus court.
